blockerResolution.description: Trent's Blocker Resolution Directive §9 — SECURITY-AGENT ENFORCEMENT. Deterministic deny-layer: DENY_ALWAYS / DENY / CONDITIONAL_DENY with compound AND conditions over caller-asserted facts. This layer can only DENY or abstain — never grant. No LLM may override it.

conditions.description: Condition mini-language: '<fact> <op> <value>' with op in == != > < >= <=. Values: true/false, numbers, quoted or bare strings (PASS, PRESENT, hex hashes — exact match).

effect.description: DENY and DENY_ALWAYS deny unconditionally. CONDITIONAL_DENY denies unless ALL conditions hold simultaneously.

blockerResolution.title: Keel blocker-resolution rules

description: Contract for Keel security policy rule files, validated by policy/engine.py at load (hand-rolled, stdlib-only). rules/base_rules.json matches #/definitions/baseRules; rules/blocker_resolution.json matches #/definitions/blockerResolution.
